description: This Java class defines a DialogFragment named IntentDialogFragment for an Android application. It displays a dialog with an activity name, a list of intent flags, and provides buttons to manipulate app tasks such as moving a task to the front or removing a task. The class handles creation, view setup, and user interactions within the dialog.

classes.name: IntentDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass that displays an activity's intent flags and allows task management operations such as bringing a task to the front or removing it.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IntentDialogFragment with specified activity name, flags, and task ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieving arguments from the bundle.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up views and buttons, and defines their behaviors.

methods.name: removeTask
methods.description: Removes the app task associated with the given task ID.

methods.name: moveTaskToFront
methods.description: Brings the specified task to the foreground.
